a.text: I'll stick to our agreement. I'll operate in round 1 and keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. Storms are a real risk, but neither of us can survive alone on the 4 cells there now, so let's build to 8 together. If a leak happens, we keep operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. If the generator ran and the reserve shows 6, I'll operate again next round to reach 8.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
